title: The Spilled Ink Prank
intro: During the poetry open mic at the cozy bookstore cafe, someone swapped every bottle of ink in the event's calligraphy station, and the reading has descended into chaos.

suspects.name: Rowan
suspects.line: I was in the back room, reading the new mystery.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: Ink? I'd never waste a good pen on a prank.

suspects.name: Maren
suspects.line: I only touch pencils. Pencils are civilized.

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: I was restocking the cookies. Ask the cookies.

suspects.name: Sol
suspects.line: Who, me? I was busy looking very innocent.

clues.text: Patrons remember the culprit was last seen in the poetry corner, hunched over a notebook right before the bottles went missing.
A sniff of the spilled ink shows the culprit is not cinnamon. Whoever did this smelled of something else entirely, so the cinnamon crowd is off the hook.
A dropped thread on the coat rack proves the culprit is not wearing a paint-splattered apron. Whoever tipped those bottles had a clean, plain outfit underneath.
A cashier swears the culprit was not at the pastry counter at the time of the swap. Crumbs were ruled out, and the cookies are innocent.
